notes: Fixes the earlier incorrect remapping in the checkpoint loader. Now: (1) retinanet_resnet50_fpn(weights=None, weights_backbone=None, num_classes=91, min_size=320, max_size=640) is instantiated exactly as declared; (2) the checkpoint is handed to model.load_state_dict(state, strict=True) directly, using the ORIGINAL OrderedDict so its _metadata travels intact and TorchVision's RetinaNet legacy head-version migration via _load_from_state_dict fires normally; (3) we never rebuild or re-key the state dict, never shape-remap keys, never accept partial coverage; missing or unexpected keys raise; (4) only well-known container wrappers ('model', 'state_dict', ...) are tried, each with a freshly constructed model, and metadata is preserved; (5) if the strict load fails for all candidates, detect and doctor fail loudly with the full error report — no randomly-initialized head layers survive. Same deliverables (detections.json, catalog.json, run.json), query and doctor contracts, CUDA-required behavior, synchronized timings, no CPU fallback and no mock weights.
